newsitem.title: USA: Japan expert nominated for U.S. Treasury post.
newsitem.headline: Japan expert nominated for U.S. Treasury post.

text.p: Japan expert Timothy Geithner was nominated on Friday by President Clinton for promotion to the post of Assistant Secretary of the Treasury for International Affairs, the Treasury Department announced.

Geithner, 35, currently is Senior Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Treasury for International Affairs. If confirmed, he will fill the post held by David Lipton, who was nominated last week to become Under Secretary of the Treasury for International Affairs.

"Tim Geithner has made an important contribution to our international economic policy team by playing a key role in formulating our U.S. exchange rate policy and U.S. policy toward Japan," Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said.
The nomination requires approval by the Senate.
